name: osint_sweep
description: Open-source intelligence sweeps across identity vectors: username enumeration across a site list, e-mail reputation and breach history, phone-number line-type and carrier, and person-name co-occurrence. Every source is classified passive (P0), DNS-based (P1) or direct-contact (P2) before it runs, and only P0 runs by default - P1 and P2 need an explicit activity class plus a policy allow rule. Each result carries a per-source outcome with its stop reason, and an empty source is reported as empty rather than as a failure.
triggers: is this email in a breach

operation.description: One of: tools | username | email | phone | person | reputation | breach_check | sweep | sources. Defaults to tools.

username.description: Username or handle to look for across the site list.

email.description: Email address for reputation or breach checks.

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 or national format.

person.description: Person name to search for co-occurring accounts.

activity.description: Activity class to permit: p0 (passive, default) | p1 (DNS) | p2 (direct contact). Only p0 runs without an explicit request and a policy rule.

authorized.description: Must be true for p1 or p2 activity.

confirm.description: Must be true for p1 or p2 activity.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 40.

author: Stella
notes: Sherlock-style username enumeration, SpiderFoot-style source taxonomy, theHarvester-style per-source outcome reporting. P0 passive only by default.
